statement: ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K] [CharZero K], let theta := fun (q u : K) => ∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2) * u^(2*n+1); ∀ (r z : K), r^14=(29:K) → 0 < ‖r‖ → ‖r‖ < 1 → z^7=1 → ‖z‖=1 → ‖1+z^2‖=1 → ‖theta (r^14) z / theta (r^14) (r^2*z) - (1+z^2)*r^2‖ ≤ ‖r‖^4
